F1.Rates Module: Owns the parallel fan-out to enabled carriers, normalisation and 10-min quote cache.

F2.Labels Module: Purchases the label, stores the PDF to S3 (ordinary file write stays here).
F2.Idempotency Middleware: Replays the stored response and rejects reuse with different parameters - the 'exactly one label' rule.
F2.Idempotency Cache: Store-specific: a new Redis keyspace with 24h TTL keyed by (org, idempotency key).

F3.Carrier Tracking Poller: Detects the carrier's delivered status on the 15-min poll.
F3.Tracking Module: Applies the status change to Shipment state and raises the delivered transition.
F3.Event Outbox: Writes shipment.delivered in the same transaction as the state change.
F3.Webhook Dispatcher: Signs, POSTs, retries with backoff for 3 days.
F3.Webhook Endpoint Console: Only place the developer registers the endpoint, subscribes to the event type and gets the signing secret; no separate feature covers it.

F4.Rate Limiter & Access Logger: Source of billable rate-request counts (cost points on the usage queue).
F4.Labels Module: Records the billable label.created usage fact (added after reading the sets - see keyChanges).
F4.Usage Aggregator: Rolls facts into hourly rows and pushes Stripe meter events.
F4.Usage Ledger: Store-specific: monthly partitions, 13-month retention, unique (key, hour, metric) constraint.
F4.Account & Key Console: Running-usage view in the portal and the Stripe customer/payment integration (section 9).

F5.Account & Key Console: Create with read-only scope, rotate with grace, revoke, show once.
F5.Key Authenticator: Its Responsibility lists org/mode/plan only - must gain scope resolution and rejection of out-of-scope calls, plus accept old key during grace.
F5.Key Lifecycle Worker: Expires the rotated key after the grace window.

F6.API Contract Layer: Reads Parcelo-Version, defaults to the key's pin, transforms, adds Deprecation/Sunset headers.
F6.Key Authenticator: Must resolve and forward the key's pinned version; not in its current Responsibility.
F6.Account & Key Console: Developer sets the pin per key; pinning is not in its current Responsibility.
F6.API Reference & Changelog: Publishes the changelog and deprecation dates.

keyChanges: F4: added Labels Module. Both sets linked it and its section-6 Responsibility explicitly includes 'records the billable label.created usage fact', which exists only to feed F4; I had wrongly treated it as covered by F2.

missing: Idempotency Cache - store-specific work by the convention (new Redis keyspace with 24h retention)
wrong: API Contract Layer - shared plumbing used, not changed

Y links documentation as feature work (API Reference & Changelog in F3) when the feature works without it.
Y adds a defence-in-depth check in Labels Module for F5 after already assigning scope resolution to Key Authenticator - double-counting one rule across two components.
Y pulls a billing concern (Rate Limiter cost-point weight) into F1 where it belongs to F4.
